This year will go down in history as the year Avail’s game changing DA network went live on mainnet, launched with the entire
feature set
of Full Danksharding. Avail forged strategic partnerships with the
5 major Ethereum Rollups
including Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Starknet, and ZKsync and welcomed over 100 ecosystem partners.
Let’s take a moment to celebrate the milestones we conquered together in 2024!
Development
Avail mainnet went live!
Entire
feature set
of full Danksharding.
Fastest DA layer
, 15x faster than the next fastest
First-ever validity proof based DA with Data Availability Sampling (DAS)
Light Client network deployed, enabling anyone to verify from their phone.
The
AVAIL token launched
along with Avail’s
Unification Drop
.
Validator network deployed
which has since expanded to 77 with more coming.
Shared
Avail’s Unification Vision
along with
Nexus
to solve rollup interoperability &
Fusion
for added crypto-economic security.
Data Usage and adoption - since launching Avail DA has processed
2 GB of data
.
Fundraising
Raised
$27m Seed Round
.
Closed a
$43m Series A
, bringing total funding (including pre-seed) to $75m.
Partnerships
We launched integrations with the 5 major Ethereum Rollup Stacks -
Arbitrum
,
Optimism
,
Polygon
,
StarkWare
,
ZKSync
and many more.
Lens
announced
they will be deploying on Avail to build scalable and resilient decentralized social networks.
Avail & Symbiotic
announced
a strategic partnership to integrate multi-asset re-staking into Fusion.
Sophon
, first validium to use external DA layer
Mainnet went live
with more than 2GB posted to Avail DA. Avail LST token holders are
earning rewards
in Sophon’s Farming program, and Aerodrome Finance is providing
AERO rewards to AVAIL LPs
on Base.
Along with many, many more!
DeFi
stAVAIL token holders have been collecting rewards from
Sophon & Avail’s Unified Token Initiative
.
AVAIL-USDC pool LP providers on
Aerodrome finance
(on Base chain) have earned ~166k USD worth of AERO within 2 months
Community
Established the Avail Foundation
to build digital, trust-minimized systems that help increase trust in our connected society.
Grew a robust social media presence across multiple platforms, reaching over 665k+ community members globally, with 300k+ followers on X, 195k+ members on Discord and a Telegram audience of 140k+
Hosted Hot Takes side events at Token 2049, ETHDenver and ETHCC Brussels
Hosted the Unification Cup, a Football oriented side-event bringing together builders from across the ecosystem at ETHCC Brussels and DevCon Bangkok.
The AVAIL token was listed on multiple exchanges including: Bybit, Whitebit, Kucoin, HTX, BingX, Bitget, Bithumb, Gate.io, HiBT, BVOX, Bitrue, Ourbit, Tapbit, CoinEx, Phemex, MEXC Global, Bilaxy, Mudrex, NovaDAX.
And that’s a wrap! But before we go, here are some network updates on what went down in December.
December 2024
Technical Update
A new version of the
light client
is being tested. This version improves the client stability regarding its memory use.
Work has been ongoing the past few months to improve the client libraries for interacting with the Avail network, especially Avail Rust. As well as the associated documentation and examples. If you’re using our libraries, or plan on using them to interact with Avail, please provide feedback as this helps us improve them further!
Network Update
Transparency Report 10:
Successfully expanded the mainnet validator active set to 77 validators, continuing our steady growth in network decentralization.
Turing network is soon to see a lowering of the active set to 80, to ensure network performance is maintained.
The Validator Dashboard is now active at
validator.availproject.org
, designed for precise network monitoring
During India Blockchain Week we hosted a breakfast and dinner with Avail frens and heard from senior R&D developer QEDK on blockchain scalability and interoperability at FILBangalore. We’ll be starting off 2025 with an Avail Shenzhen Meetup, Consensus Hong Kong, and of course, ETH Denver!
